  s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
  COUNT(d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_library_materials,
  MIN(c.CATALOG_YEAR) AS min_publication_year,
  MAX(c.CATALOG_YEAR) AS max_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS total_materials_status

JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c

GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE
ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE

  s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
  COUNT(c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_materials,
  MIN(c.CATALOG_YEAR) AS min_pub_year,
  MAX(c.CATALOG_YEAR) AS max_pub_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS total_material_status
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY

SELECT lci.COURSE_NAME,
       COUNT(lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_library_materials,
       MIN(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR) AS min_pub_year,
       MAX(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR) AS max_pub_year,
       COUNT(lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS total_materials_status
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci ON lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc ON lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms ON lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY lci.COURSE_NAME
LIMIT 20
